column3: NKJV includes “brethren,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV includes “Take, eat” and “broken,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “This is My body which is for you.”
NKJV has “this cup,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the cup.”
NKJV includes “in an unworthy manner” and “the Lord's body,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “eats and drinks” and “the body.”
